visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four young adults, two men and two women, sit around a black table in a dimly lit indoor space with wood-paneled walls and a bookshelf. The main character, a man wearing glasses and a brown jacket over a green shirt, sits centrally. They are all holding yellow and green 'Mine Shine' juice boxes and laughing. (2) A fast-paced montage shows individual close-ups of the four people. Each person looks directly at the camera with an intense expression while drinking from their juice box through a straw. The background is a blurred domestic interior. (3) The man in the brown jacket looks at his smartphone, which he holds in his right hand. He gestures as if taking a call and stands up, picking up a large black hard-shell briefcase with 'DMZ' stickers. He walks toward a wooden door and exits. (4) The scene shifts to the man inside an elevator with marble walls, looking upward. Then, he is shown running and jumping in an outdoor park with green trees. A large, bright orange CGI explosion effect is edited behind him as he mid-air leaps while holding the briefcase. (5) The man lands on a green rubberized playground surface. He opens the briefcase to reveal 'Call of Duty: Mobile' branded merchandise, including a t-shirt, a hat, and cards. He appears in a series of quick cuts wearing a fake mustache, sliding down a yellow slide, and sitting next to a stuffed dog. (6) The video returns to the original indoor setting. The three remaining friends are seen talking and looking puzzled. The final shot shows an older woman in a striped shirt and a beige knitted hat also drinking from a 'Mine Shine' juice box against a plain wall.

It moves to an elevator with polished marble and gold trim, and then to an outdoor public park featuring green trees, a yellow playground slide, and a green mat surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with energetic group laughter and overlapping casual chatter. The background music is a light, playful acoustic track. (2) A series of six loud, wet, and highly exaggerated slurping sound effects occur as the characters drink through straws. Each slurp is synchronized with a visual cut. (3) The main speaker delivers a loud, high-pitched greeting 'Eh!' followed by a rapid-fire, animated phone conversation. The BGM shifts to a neutral ambient track. (4) As the man enters the elevator, the audio transitions into a dramatic, epic cinematic score with driving percussion and synth risers. A massive 'BOOM' impact sound accompanies the CGI explosion. (5) The audio transitions into high-energy, fast-tempo electronic dance music. The narrator speaks in a very fast, rhythmic, promotional tone, listing product features. Several 'Whoosh' and 'Ding' UI sound effects are interspersed. (6) The audio cuts back to lower-arousal conversation between the friends in the indoor setting, with a final, long, exaggerated slurping sound concluding the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Conflict -> Action Transition -> Promotional Presentation -> Comedic Tag
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic skit about awkward social situations to transition into a high-energy promotional unboxing for the mobile game 'Call of Duty: Mobile' (決勝時刻M). It aims to entertain viewers with absurd humor while showcasing the game's 6th-anniversary rewards and collaboration with Street Fighter 6.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The main character explicitly unboxes branded merchandise, shows gameplay footage, and mentions specific game features and anniversary rewards.
